The Trump Administration said yesterday that it no longer plans to recruit retiring Pentagon lawyers to represent unaccompanied minors in immigration court, in a statement to the New York Times. The Department of Health and Human Services added that for now it would use short-term contracts to provide migrant children with lawyers. Madeleine Ngo reports. [...] U.S. officials told CBS News yesterday that the Pentagon has discussed firing the longtime publisher of Stars and Stripes before his retirement. Max Lederer announced his decision to retire on the 30th of September on Tuesday, citing fundamental differences with the Trump administration. Jennifer Jacobs reports.
